name: icloud
description: Use iCloud web apps through ChatGPT's persistent cloud browser session without a local server.

interface.shortDescription: Use iCloud apps through the cloud browser.
interface.longDescription: Automatically opens iCloud web apps in ChatGPT's cloud browser and reuses the signed-in session for Mail, Calendar, Photos, Drive, Notes, Contacts, Reminders, and related tasks without a local server or always-on Mac.
defaultPrompt: Show my upcoming iCloud Calendar events.
